description: Source file implementing the QboneSessionBase class for managing QUIC sessions with QBONE protocol, including stream handling, packet sending, and connection management.

classes.name: QboneSessionBase
classes.description: Class managing QBONE-specific QUIC session behaviors, including stream creation, packet processing, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: QboneSessionBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QBONE session with connection, owner, config, supported versions, and writer.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the crypto stream and other session parameters.

methods.name: GetCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the crypto stream.

methods.name: GetMutableCryptoStream
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the crypto stream.

methods.name: CreateOutgoingStream
methods.description: Creates and activates a new outgoing data stream.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames, processes ephemeral packets, and optionally resets streams.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates an incoming data stream with a given ID.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Stub for creating incoming streams from pending streams, not reached.

methods.name: ShouldKeepConnectionAlive
methods.description: Indicates that QBONE connections stay alive until explicitly closed.

methods.name: CreateDataStream
methods.description: Creates a data stream if encryption is established; distinguishes between read-only and write-only streams.

methods.name: ActivateDataStream
methods.description: Transfers ownership of a stream to the session.

methods.name: SendPacketToPeer
methods.description: Sends a packet to the peer, either as a message or via ephemeral streams, with error handling.

methods.name: GetNumEphemeralPackets
methods.description: Returns the count of ephemeral packets.

methods.name: GetNumStreamedPackets
methods.description: Returns the count of streamed packets.

methods.name: GetNumMessagePackets
methods.description: Returns the count of message packets.

methods.name: GetNumFallbackToStream
methods.description: Returns the count of fallback to stream events.

methods.name: set_writer
methods.description: Sets the packet writer and adjusts test values.
